citation: Crummett LT, Grosso RJ (2022). Postprandial Glycemic Response to Whole Fruit versus Blended Fruit in Healthy, Young Adults. Nutrients 14(21):4565.
protocol: Gala apple (190 g) + blackberries (148 g), crossover: eaten whole vs blended into a smoothie (with 100 mL water, 100 g ice). Blood glucose every 10 min for 60 min.
population: n=20 young healthy college students (12 women, 8 men).

reports.where: Table 1: max, iAUC, 60-min incremental value per form, by sex and all

note: Paired-meal contrast, form: whole fruit vs the same fruit blended. Exactly matched form contrast (same fruit). Watch: glucose only (likely capillary), 60 min only, and values are incremental (baseline subtracted). Only in figures: glucose time course.
